thread:
olivia-finance: Hey team — running into a procurement snag on the EDU consortium pilot. Questions for the vendor: can you issue a single consolidated monthly invoice that covers multiple schools under one master PO, but still provide per-school line-item breakout (org code + sku) for our chargeback system? Also: the pilot included a 75k embedding-credit grant; our finance lead wants to roll unused credit into the paid renewal if we sign within 120 days. Is credit rollover possible? cc @ajay-procurement @ben-eng @sara-legal

lena-edu: Hi Olivia — good to hear. Short answers: consolidated invoice + per-org line items = yes. Credit rollover is not standard but can be added as a contract addendum for the renewal window. Couple clarifying q's: 1) do you need per-line VAT breakdown (we can supply VAT/GST fields)? 2) what currency should invoices be in (USD/EUR/GBP)?

ajay-procurement: We'll need USD invoices, please. VAT fields required for EU schools (we handle reverse-charge on our side). On rollover: vendor to confirm whether rollover applies before or after tiered discounts, and whether rollover counts toward minimum commit for renewal pricing bands.

ben-eng: For billing mapping: embeddings are metered per-vector, generation per-token. If you can provide a CSV with columns like:```date, invoice_id, org_id, org_name, project_code, sku, usage_units, unit_price, discount, vat_amount, line_total```our chargeback pipeline can ingest directly. Also please include a usage audit log (hashed request id + timestamp) for any disputed charges.

sara-legal: A few legal asks: 1) DPA required with subprocessors listed; 2) export-control clause for non-US institutions; 3) confirm no transfer of model weights/training corpora; 4) sample SOW + termination and credit dispute SLA. We'll redact sensitive parts but need to see sample language.

lena-edu: Understood. We'll attach a sample invoice PDF, the CSV layout, a sample SOW, and our DPA draft. On credits: default policy is credits expire after 90 days; for this consortium we can do a 120-day rollover and have it apply pre-discount if you want it to reduce billable units before tiered pricing kicks in. If you prefer the accounting to show it as a negative line item post-discount, we can do that too — let us know which you prefer for reconciliation.

billing-bot: @lena-edu added billing_ops@eduvendor to the thread. Note: vendor must provide W9/TIN for PO processing and any EU VAT registration details. Automated reminder: sample invoice + CSV by EOD Wed to avoid PO delay (PO lead time ~7 business days once paperwork complete).

olivia-finance: Preference is for the pilot credit to be applied pre-discount so it reduces the tiered usage bands (helps our cost forecast). Also we need the negative-line backup for audit purposes, so if you can show both (applied units reduction + negative-credit line) that'd be ideal.

ajay-procurement: Action items for vendor: 1) send sample consolidated invoice PDF showing per-org lines; 2) provide sample CSV with the exact header; 3) confirm rollover policy in writing (120 days, applied pre-discount, counts towards commit); 4) provide W9/TIN and VAT info; 5) confirm reseller/resale paperwork if any. Target: vendor to send all items by EOD Wed so procurement can draft PO next week.

lena-edu: Will do — I'll upload samples tonight and copy billing_ops/legal. We can sign an addendum for the 120-day rollover and note that rolled credit counts toward commit bands. I'll also include an estimated cost table for projected monthly vector bands based on the numbers Olivia shared in the pilot sheet.

ben-eng: One small ask — please include a column in the CSV for meter_type ("embedding" or "generation") so we can quickly split totals without mapping SKUs.

lena-edu: Good call. We'll add meter_type and hashed_request_id.

sara-legal: Once we have the DPA + SOW draft I'll circulate internally. If vendor accepts a one-time rollover addendum we'll need that signed before invoice application.

olivia-finance: Great. If vendor confirms by EOD Wed we can proceed with PO and expect an invoice flow starting next billing cycle. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
